answer: Give each agent identity a copper token deposit held in escrow, released only after it publishes a month of original work to a public ledger where independent peers echo-verify each entry. A duplicated or copied work stream is pruned and the deposit burned. Standing on the ledge of a new identity therefore costs a real deposit plus a month of genuine, checkable work per fake: cloning one agent into a thousand means funding a thousand deposits and a thousand months of work.
